description: This source file manages thread priorities and scheduling policies on a Raspberry Pi 4 platform, including setting thread schedulers to idle, other, or round-robin with specific priorities, and retrieving thread priorities.

methods.name: SetIdleScheduler
methods.description: Sets the current thread's scheduler to SCHED_IDLE with priority 0.

methods.name: SetOtherScheduler
methods.description: Sets the current thread's scheduler to SCHED_OTHER with priority 0.

methods.name: SetRoundRobinScheduler
methods.description: Sets the current thread's scheduler to SCHED_RR with a specified priority, considering system limits.

methods.name: ThreadSetPriority
methods.description: Sets thread priority based on the provided SbThreadPriority enum.

methods.name: SbThreadSetPriority
methods.description: Public API to set thread priority, calls ThreadSetPriority internally.

methods.name: SbThreadGetPriority
methods.description: Retrieves the current thread's priority as an SbThreadPriority enum.
